decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new pressure and vacuum relief valves.

items.material_name: Building pressure and vacuum relief valve, 650 Pa in either direction, minimum 900 m³/h, 1.4301 stainless steel housing, DN 200 branch
items.description: Maintenance-free valve with a matching branch connection for the DN 200 stainless steel pipe.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new thermal mass flowmeter supplied with a calibrated precision measuring section.

items.material_name: Thermal air mass flowmeter with DN 200 × 350 mm flanged measuring section, 0–10,000 Nm³/h, IP65, 24 V DC, 4–20 mA
items.description: Compact sealed-sensor meter calibrated with its precision flow section; designed for 40–70 mbar gauge operating pressure.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new bulk bag discharger, including its iris valve and support stand.

items.material_name: BBE-2.1-type low-profile bulk bag discharger, 1.4301 stainless steel, 120 × 100 cm bag footprint, 1,190 mm frame height, 350 mm lift stroke, BIDV-7.1-S-S long iris valve
items.description: Gas-spring-assisted discharger with a manual cable iris dosing valve and a front-open support stand approximately 1,200 mm high.

decisions.reason: The position explicitly requires supply and installation of a new stationary solids-handling jet pump.

items.material_name: Stationary liquid-jet solids pump, FFeP type, reference order number 181001 473195
items.description: Stationary liquid-driven jet pump for conveying solids, supplied ready for operation.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new water-jet aerator; testing and commissioning are included.

items.material_name: DN 150 water-jet aerator, 60 m³/h motive water, 120 Nm³/h air suction, 1.4571 stainless steel body, DN 100 PN 16 motive inlet, DN 150 PN 10 outlet
items.description: Vertical aerator for well-water deacidification and oxygenation, with replaceable motive nozzle and DN 80 suction throttle valve.

decisions.reason: The position requires new filter nozzles to be supplied and installed after the existing nozzles are removed.

items.material_name: S3-type air-cushion filter underdrain nozzle, minimum 2 mm air slot and working bore, minimum 5 mm height adjustment
items.description: Replacement nozzle for an open filter bed, with a burr-free slot and working bore.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of two distinct filter media layers, each with its own amount per filter.

items.material_name: Washed, kiln-dried quartz filter support gravel, DIN 12904, 2.00–3.15 mm, 30 cm layer
items.description: Graded quartz gravel for the support layer of an open arsenic removal filter.

items.material_name: GEH 102 granular ferric hydroxide arsenic adsorption media, 1.20 m filter layer
items.description: Granular adsorbent for arsenic removal, supplied in bulk bags.
